title: Finite boundary mass of a slice-composed current via the slice homotopy identities
statement: Notation: ι(t, x) := WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x)) ∈ ℝ^{N+1} for t ∈ ℝ, x ∈ ℝ^N; Jv := ι(0, v) = WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 0 (WithLp.ofLp v)); e₀ := EuclideanSpace.single 0 1 ∈ ℝ^{N+1}; |α| := covectorEuclideanNorm α; 𝒟^m(ℝ^P) := TestFormOn univ m and 𝒟_m(ℝ^P) := GeometricCurrentOn univ m (forms and currents on all of ℝ^P = Euclid P); M(T) := T.mass = T.massOn univ; spt T := T.support. d := exteriorDerivative. Assume (MSB): for all N, k ∈ ℕ, X ∈ 𝒟_k(ℝ^N) with M(X) < ∞, ψ ∈ 𝒟^k(ℝ^N) and c ∈ ℝ with |ψ(x)| ≤ c for every x ∈ spt X, |X(ψ)| ≤ c·M(X).toReal; (SLB): for all N, k ∈ ℕ, s ∈ ℝ and ω ∈ 𝒟^k(ℝ^{N+1}) there is ρ ∈ 𝒟^k(ℝ^N) with ρ(x)(v_1, …, v_k) = ω(ι(s, x))(Jv_1, …, Jv_k) for all x, v; (SLC): for all N, k ∈ ℕ, β ∈ 𝒟^{k+1}(ℝ^{N+1}) and θ ∈ 𝒟^k(ℝ^N) with θ(x)(v) = ∫_0^1 β(ι(t, x))(e₀, Jv_1, …, Jv_k) dt for all x and v ∈ (ℝ^N)^k, one has for all x and v = (v_0, …, v_k) ∈ (ℝ^N)^{k+1}: ∫_0^1 dβ(ι(t, x))(e₀, Jv_0, …, Jv_k) dt = β(ι(1, x))(Jv_0, …, Jv_k) − β(ι(0, x))(Jv_0, …, Jv_k) − dθ(x)(v); (SLD): for all N, β ∈ 𝒟^0(ℝ^{N+1}), x ∈ ℝ^N and the empty tuple v: ∫_0^1 dβ(ι(t, x))(e₀) dt = β(ι(1, x))() − β(ι(0, x))(); (R2): for all N, k there is a continuous linear map Ψ from k-covectors on ℝ^{N+1} to k-covectors on ℝ^N with Ψ(γ)(v_1, …, v_k) = γ(Jv_1, …, Jv_k) and |Ψ(γ)| ≤ |γ|. Let N, k ∈ ℕ, X ∈ 𝒟_k(ℝ^N) with M(X) < ∞ and boundaryMassOn X univ < ∞ (that is, M(∂X) < ∞ when k ≥ 1; it is 0 when k = 0), Z ∈ 𝒟_{k+1}(ℝ^{N+1}), and maps S_m : 𝒟^{m+1}(ℝ^{N+1}) → 𝒟^m(ℝ^N) (m ∈ ℕ) such that for every m: S_m(ω)(x)(v_1, …, v_m) = ∫_0^1 ω(ι(t, x))(e₀, Jv_1, …, Jv_m) dt for all ω, x, v, and |S_m(ω)(x)| ≤ c for all x whenever c ∈ ℝ and |ω(y)| ≤ c for all y. If Z(ω) = X(S_k(ω)) for all ω ∈ 𝒟^{k+1}(ℝ^{N+1}), then M(∂Z) < ∞.
